item.name: Telephony API

request.description: WebSocket endpoint for telephony providers (Twilio, Telnyx, Exotel, Plivo). Connect via ws://localhost:8000/ws. The server accepts the connection, parses the first telephony messages to identify the provider and call data, resolves the agent by the 'to' phone number, and runs the voice pipeline.
